key_facts: Italy has about 700 military personnel deployed to the Gulf region to help partner nations counter Iranian attacks.
Approximately 400 Italian Air Force personnel have been in Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and Kuwait since March under Task Force Air-Arabia.
A 260-strong Italian Army component, Task Force Land-Arabia, is also deployed, including a SAMP/T air defense battery and Kronos radar in Saudi Arabia.
Task Group C-UAS is equipped with the Leonardo-made ACUS-E anti-drone system designed to counter small drones.
Italian opposition lawmakers have criticized the deployment as lacking a parliamentary mandate, which Defense Minister Guido Crosetto disputes, citing a March 5 parliamentary resolution.
